text.p: Apple Computer Inc. reported a second-quarter loss of $708 million Wednesday, reflecting one-time charges and weaker sales by the troubled computer maker.

Apple said the loss for the quarter ended March 28, which equaled $5.64 a share, compared with a loss of $740 million, or $5.99 a share, in the year-ago quarter, when Apple was also hit by one-time charges. Revenues fell to $1.6 billion in the latest quarter from $2.19 billion in last year's quarter.
